newsitem.title: USA: Santa Anita Cos reaffirm Colony alliance.
newsitem.headline: Santa Anita Cos reaffirm Colony alliance.

text.p: Santa Anita Cos said Sunday that the boards of directors of Santa Anita Realty Enterprises and Santa Anita Operating Cos have reaffirmed their committment to the previously announced strategic alliance with Colony Capital and its affiliates.
Santa Anita said that the boards have determined that the proposal received from Apollo/Koll is incomplete.
The company said it has directed its financial advisors to begin discussions with Apollo/Koll if Apollo/Koll sufficiently addresses its concerns.

Among the concerns the company listed in a letter to Apollo/Koll were the nature and feasability of the proposed up-front cash dividned, post-dividend valuation and plans for future operation and governance of the comapnies.
